Svelte 5 takes `<head>`, `<body>`, `<window>`, `<document>`, `<element>` and `<options>` for plain HTML elements. The special elements that Svelte 4 accepted under these names are `<svelte:head>` and the like.

`--fix` adds the `svelte:` prefix to the start tag and the end tag.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-raw-special-elements": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<head>
  <title>Settings</title>
</head>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<svelte:head>
  <title>Settings</title>
</svelte:head>
```
